title: Rust SCHC Rules0/5 match fe80::/10 while reconstructing exact fe80::/64
description: Correctness review: Rust selects Rules0/5 for any fe80::/10 address but elides/reconstructs an exact fe80::/64 prefix, corrupting valid non-/64 link-local addresses. Use exact link-local /64 matching for every IID-only rule. Shared fe80:0:0:1:: vectors must fall back to Rule255 and round-trip unchanged in Python/Rust.
